name: anim_embrace4_squeeze
subject: a pink goo Doberman monster lying on top of a pink goo crocodile monster on a sticky paint puddle, with a small black witch cat squashed and buried between their bodies
desc: Loop: the Doberman on top presses down and grinds against the cat while the crocodile underneath squeezes up from below, their bodies squishing and bulging around the buried cat; the trapped cat wriggles; thick goo strands stretch and drip down into the sticky floor puddle. The floor puddle itself stays still, no bubbles. The crocodile's head and face do not change. Heavy, sticky, viscous.
